turns.assessment: The event is a hard optical plant break adjacent to S20, not a client or channel-specific failure. At the same instant, OSC was lost in both directions on the S20–S01 and S20–S13 routes, while downstream amplifiers reported input LOS and their pump currents did not change. The simultaneous loss of multiple cables leaving S20 is characteristic of an excavation/duct cut; the documented fibre-cut mode explicitly allows other cables in the same duct to be severed.

proposals.rationale: O107 identifies OSC loss on the first span from S20 toward S01, with the reciprocal alarm O105 on the same physical route. Simultaneous reciprocal OSC loss on S20–S13 and widespread all-channel LOS indicate the incident also cut another cable sharing the S20-side duct. This common physical incident explains svc375 and the broad set of affected working paths through S20.
